rules.accepted_credit_types: Approved providers under 49 Pa. Code §33.403; live interactive webinars count as lecture
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from the 30 hours for the biennial period of initial licensure (e.g. licensed 4/1/23-3/31/25); child abuse training still required.
rules.alternatives: Written waiver request for illness, emergency or hardship, decided case by case.
rules.audit_note: Child abuse course completion must be reported electronically by the approved provider; do not upload certificates.

topics.who: Act 31 mandated child abuse recognition and reporting, from an approved provider
Act 124 opioid education; not needed without a DEA registration or use of another's DEA number
Current infant, child and adult CPR; hands-on CPR courses do not count as CE

rules.notes: At least 50% lecture/clinical; max 50% online/individual study. Current infant, child and adult CPR required; hands-on CPR courses do not count as CE. Anesthesia permit holders: 15 h in GA/deep sedation (unrestricted) or conscious sedation (restricted I), plus ACLS/PALS.
